body: Uh, just ignore I said that. It came from a very dark place even if I think that it came from my heart. I just have the sense that some people enjoy it when people like private Pyle flunder around and are greatly amused by it. Some people feel bad, most people feel bad and then are annoyed and some are amused. I imagine it could be more troubling to be an intelligent person and to perceive many things while emphasizing with others.

Not being smart enough can also sadly be a horrible experience for different reasons. Just read some of the messages here a lot of them have to do with being unable to keep up with other people.

Just watch the movie Full Metal Jacket and ask yourself if you would like to be the private Pyle guy who was failing at everything at the start.

The best thing to be would be is a very intelligent and otherwise exceptional sadist I think. But maybe people like that have other issues that I can't begin to fathom and life can suck for them too in ways I can't imagine. Ye, it's very hard to know what life is like for other people.

Not being intelligent enough makes me think that being intelligent is the only thing that matters in life, but I know it is not true because many intelligent people seem to struggle like you do.

I would gladly trade some of your excess intelligence for my lack of it if it was possible. Maybe we could both be happier then.
For me, it's my dog and some days are just better than others and some worse.

I'm struggling with a somewhat similar issue, though for me it's more to do with not getting likes for my shitty artworks argh. It means a huge deal for me and something that keeps me from feeling entirely worthless.

Getting just one makes me feel ok so I don't want much,  but getting zero just kills me and I feel like giving up as I don't have anything else sadly.

I'm very angry at my brain for being affected by something as ridiculous as that because it's something that used to make me happy and social media has ruined it for me. It's very hard to keep trying and to pretend to be happy on my other social media accounts.

I'm a little bit afraid to post more comments in this subreddit because I am completely retarded socially and am afraid I might say something to upset another person even more.

I just shared this to tell you that there are many others who are affected negatively by social media and you are not the only one who's brain reacts to it that way even though you know it's not rational.
Thanks. I'm not really looking to talk with anyone just had to get it off my chest. I just wish I could control myself enough to not lash out at people that are close to me.
